# Release Notes

<!-- TODO(release lead): confirm pre-release vs stable, and tune this summary. -->
Node version `11.2.0` is a pre-release version of `cardano-node` that is not yet recommended for use on mainnet. Its headline change is the move to the new **cardano-config** library for reading node configuration: the node now understands a versioned configuration "envelope" alongside the existing flat format, and the configuration files published for each network are now in the envelope format. It also extends the gRPC interface, continues the groundwork for the Dijkstra era, Leios and Peras, and fixes several operator-facing bugs.

Highlights:

- **New configuration format.** Configurations are read through [cardano-config](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-config).
  - Existing flat configurations still work.
  - The new envelope format (`$schema` / `Version` / `MinNodeVersion` / `Configuration`) is schema-validated.
  - New `cardano-node config migrate`, `cardano-node config schema` and `cardano-node config resolve` subcommands convert, describe and check a configuration.
  - The shipped network configs are now enveloped and **cannot be read by nodes older than 11.2**.
- **gRPC over HTTP/2.** The gRPC server can now listen on a TCP address/port, in plaintext (h2c) or with TLS (`--grpc-listen-address`/`--grpc-listen-port`, `--grpc-tls-*`), instead of only a unix socket.
- **New gRPC methods** `ReadMempool`, `WatchMempool` and `ReadEraSummary`, plus server reflection.
- **Node-to-client versions older than `NodeToClientV_23` are no longer supported.** Clients (wallets, indexers, tools) must be built against a version of the network libraries that speaks `NodeToClientV_23` (shipped since node 10.7.0).
- **Ledger snapshots** are now taken by default every `40 * k` slots with no offset (once a day on mainnet).
- The node traces the resolved snapshot policy at startup, and warns if it is implausible for the network's slot length.
- Continued Dijkstra-era work:
  - `cardano-cli` supports sub-transactions and guard credentials.
  - `cardano-submit-api` accepts Dijkstra transactions.
  - The CIP-0168 Plutus builtins have a cost model.
- Groundwork for Leios and Peras (off by default).

# Known issues

<!-- TODO(test/perf engineers): add known issues, or "None known." -->

# Breaking changes

- **Configuration files**: the published `mainnet-config.json`/`.yaml` (and other network configs) are in the cardano-config envelope format and are not readable by pre-11.2 nodes. Flat configurations remain supported by 11.2.0; use `cardano-node config migrate` to convert one.
- **Docker**: `CARDANO_CONFIG_JSON_MERGE` is a plain deep merge, so a merge document written for the flat shape silently does nothing against an enveloped config. Nest keys under `Configuration.<Section>` (e.g. `{"Configuration":{"HermodTracing":{"TraceOptions":…}}}`); see `nix/docker/README.md`.
- **Node-to-client**: `NodeToClientV_16` – `NodeToClientV_22` were removed, along with the queries only they could reach: `GetProposedPParamsUpdates`, `GetStakeDistribution` (use `GetStakeDistribution2`) and `GetPoolDistr` (use `GetPoolDistr2`).
- **NixOS service**: `blsKeys` (added in 11.1) is replaced by a single `blsKey`; multiple keys go in one file as a JSON array of text envelopes.
- **Tracing**: log consumers should note the changes listed in the "Tracing" changelog below (mempool `"tx"` field is now hex CBOR, renamed `DelegAccountAlreadyRegistered` failure, new namespaces; trace forwarding config change).
- **cardano-cli**: `node issue-pop-BLS` and `node key-hash-BLS` were removed. Proof-of-possession is built into `stake-pool registration-certificate --bls-signing-key-file`.
- **cardano-cli**: `--script-valid`/`--script-invalid` were removed from the Dijkstra `transaction build*` commands (Conway unaffected).

# Technical Specification

<details open>
  <summary>Minimum System Requirements</summary>

- An Intel or AMD x86 processor with two or more cores, at 1.6GHz or faster (2GHz or faster for a stake pool or relay)
- Or, for MacOS, an Apple Silicon processor
- 24GB of RAM when running with the `InMemory` backend, 8GB when running with the `OnDisk` backend (pending confirmation)
- 300GB of free storage (350GB recommended for future growth)

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Platforms</summary>

- Linux 64-bit (Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, 22.04 LTS, 24.04 LTS, 26.04 LTS; Mint 20, 21, 21.1, 21.2, 21.3, 22, 22.1, 22.2; Debian 11, 12, 13)
- Windows 64-bit (10, 11)
- MacOS 10.15, 11 (Big Sur), 12 (Monterey), 13 (Ventura), 14 (Sonoma), 15 (Sequoia), 26 (Tahoe)

</details>

<details open>
  <summary>GHC/Cabal supported versions</summary>

- GHC 9.6
- Cabal 3.8/3.12

</details>

# Changelogs

<details>
  <summary>cardano-node</summary>

- The node reads its configuration through `cardano-config`. Two dialects are understood: the legacy flat format (read by both the node's own parser and `cardano-config`, with any divergence reported as a non-fatal warning) and the new `cardano-config` envelope, resolved by `cardano-config` alone. New subcommands `cardano-node config migrate`, `cardano-node config schema` and `cardano-node config resolve` (the latter also reports divergences between the two parsers for a flat config). ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- The shipped network configurations were refreshed for the 11.2 series and moved to the envelope format. Release tarballs ship the enveloped config. ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- `mainnet-config.yaml` drops `LastKnownBlockVersion-*` and is no longer readable by a pre-11.2 node. ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- The gRPC server can listen over HTTP/2 instead of only a unix socket: `--grpc-listen-address`/`--grpc-listen-port` (config `RpcListenAddress`/`RpcListenPort`), and TLS via `--grpc-tls-certificate`/`--grpc-tls-private-key`/`--grpc-tls-chain-certificate`. Conflicting or incomplete combinations are rejected at parse time. ([#6668](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6668))
- Standard handles now always use UTF-8, independent of the system code page or locale. On Windows, stdout traces were written in the legacy code page, so JSON lines were not valid UTF-8, and characters outside that code page (e.g. in a non-ASCII host name or `TraceOptionNodeName`) crashed the node at startup. The same crash happened on Linux under a non-UTF-8 locale such as `LC_ALL=C`. ([#6711](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/issues/6711))
- Tracing changes visible to log consumers, now that the consensus tracing instances are used instead of the node's own copy:
  - mempool rejections always carry `errdetails`;
  - the detailed `"tx"` field of mempool traces is now the CBOR in hex;
  - new namespaces `Mempool.CapacityChanged`, `Snapshot.ConfiguredSnapshotPolicy`, `Snapshot.ImplausibleSnapshotPolicy`, `RPC.SubmitService.ReadMempool.Span` and `RPC.SubmitService.WatchMempool.Span`;
  - the Peras certificate inclusion and vote forging tracers are wired, under `Peras.Cert.Inclusion` and `Peras.Vote.Forging`;
  - the ledger predicate failure kind for an already-registered delegation account is now `DelegAccountAlreadyRegistered`.
  ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- `slotsMissed_int` no longer counts the slots that elapse while block forging is disabled; the first leadership check after forging is re-enabled starts a new run of slots. Genuine gaps while forging is enabled are still counted. ([#6698](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/issues/6698))
- Docker: the node entrypoint's relative-path rewriting now handles enveloped configs. ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- Docker: `CARDANO_CONFIG_JSON_MERGE` documents must use the enveloped shape (see `nix/docker/README.md`). ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- NixOS service: new `configFormat` option (`"legacy"`, the default, or `"enveloped"`) to choose the generated config dialect. ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- NixOS service: new `lsmExportPath` option, for the LSM snapshot export consumed by Mithril signing. ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- NixOS service: new `immutableDatabasePath` and `volatileDatabasePath` options. ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- NixOS service: `blsKeys` is replaced by a single `blsKey`. ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- The Mithril signer bundled in the `x86_64-linux` tarball was bumped to the v2642.0 release (signer 1.2.5). ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))

</details>

<details>
  <summary>cardano-tracer</summary>

- Standard handles now always use UTF-8 (on Windows also the console code page), independent of the system code page or locale. ([#6731](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6731))
- `trace-forward` 2.5.1 fixes a small memory leak in the acceptor. ([#6740](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6740))

</details>

<details>
  <summary>cardano-submit-api</summary>

- Fixed `cardano-submit-api` rejecting Dijkstra era transactions with a `TxCmdTxReadError` decoding error. Transactions from every Shelley-based era, including Dijkstra, are now decoded and submitted to the node. ([#6725](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6725))

</details>

<details>
  <summary>cardano-testnet</summary>

- New `--enable-tracer` option (experimental). It starts `cardano-tracer` and has all testnet nodes forward their traces to it. `cardano-tracer` is found via the `CARDANO_TRACER` environment variable, or on `PATH`. Its Prometheus server listens on `127.0.0.1` on a random port unless `--prometheus-listen-address` and `--prometheus-listen-port` are given. Both flags require `--enable-tracer`. ([#6710](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6710), [#6723](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6723))
- When the network is ready, `cardano-testnet cardano` writes a machine-readable `manifest.json` (sockets, ports, key paths, genesis files, wallet addresses) into the output directory, with a JSON Schema in `cardano-testnet/schemas/manifest.schema.json`. ([#6693](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6693))
- New `--enable-grpc-http` (experimental) serves each node's gRPC endpoint over HTTP without TLS (h2c). By default each node listens on `127.0.0.1` on a random port. `--grpc-listen-address` sets the address, and `--grpc-listen-port-base` gives node *i* the port `PORT+i-1`. Endpoints are printed in the startup summary. ([#6685](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6685))
- Testnet node configurations are written in the cardano-config format, with genesis hashes refreshed on every start and the node's default tracing options written out. Breaking for library users: `createConfigJson`, `createConfigJsonNoHash`, `getByronGenesisHash`, `getShelleyGenesisHash`, `GenesisHashesPolicy` and `SubmitApiConf`'s `configPath` were removed, and `getStartTime` no longer takes a path. ([#6677](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6677))
- `nix run .#cardano-testnet` now sets `CARDANO_NODE` and `CARDANO_CLI` to the cardano-node and cardano-cli from the same flake, so it runs without exporting them. Variables you export yourself still take precedence. The unwrapped binary is `.#cardano-testnet-thin`. ([#6684](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/pull/6684))

</details>

<details>
  <summary>cardano-cli</summary>

- Added Dijkstra sub-transaction commands: `build-raw`, `sign` and `txid`. Top-level `transaction build-raw` accepts signed sub-transactions through repeatable `--signed-sub-tx-file` options. Sub-transaction builders support guard credentials and required top-level guards.
- Added Plutus V4 reference-script options to Dijkstra transaction and sub-transaction builders. Sub-transactions support native scripts and Plutus V4; Plutus V1–V3 script files are rejected.
- Added `--direct-deposit STAKE_ADDRESS+LOVELACE` to Dijkstra transaction builders and sub-transaction `build-raw`, with duplicate-recipient validation, automatic fee balancing, and deposit details in transaction views.
- Added BLS voting-key registration through `stake-pool registration-certificate --bls-signing-key-file`, mandatory from Dijkstra onwards. Removed `node issue-pop-BLS` and `node key-hash-BLS`; `node key-gen-BLS` remains available.
- Added Leios protocol-parameter update options and exposed `--spec-dijkstra` in testnet genesis help.
- Removed `--script-valid` and `--script-invalid` from Dijkstra transaction builders; Conway retains both options.
- `debug check-node-configuration` accepts legacy flat and new `cardano-config` configurations. Genesis hashes are required and genesis files are fully decoded and validated. Experimental hard forks require a Dijkstra genesis file and hash. The success message now goes to stderr.
- Added repeatable `--tx-in-collateral` to `compatible transaction signed-transaction`.
- Fixed relay IPv4 address rendering, redeemer indexing, and `transaction build-estimate` balancing with no outputs or multi-asset input values.
- Improved era and script handling: `CARDANO_ERA` accepts Dijkstra and case-insensitive names; address and policy-ID commands accept Plutus V4 and native guard scripts; unsupported reference-script languages produce an error instead of being silently dropped.
- Updated to API 11.11 and its validated, insertion-ordered transaction guards.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>cardano-api</summary>

<!-- TODO(api team): review. Summarised from cardano-api 11.6.0.0 → 11.11.0.0. -->
- Added experimental Dijkstra sub-transaction construction, signing, serialisation and embedding. Unified transaction body content across top-level transactions and sub-transactions, with Dijkstra fields for guards, direct deposits and account-balance intervals.
- Added native-script guards and native/Plutus V4 guard witnesses, including fee estimation and balancing. Guard collections now use insertion-ordered `TxGuards`; callers should use `mkTxGuards` and handle validation errors.
- Added BLS stake-pool voting-key registration and Leios protocol-parameter updates.
- Added Plutus V4 reference and auxiliary scripts for Dijkstra. Unsupported script languages now fail explicitly during decoding or transaction construction.
- `readNodeConfig` and `initialLedgerState` use `cardano-config`, accepting both configuration formats and requiring genesis hashes. `readNodeConfig` loads genesis files and returns configuration warnings and structured errors. `NodeConfig` no longer has a `FromJSON` instance.
- Fixed fee estimation for voting transactions, pool registrations and key guards; redeemer pointer indexing; multi-asset and output-free balancing; non-canonical inline-datum decoding; and Dijkstra ledger-event processing.
- Extended `createCompatibleTx` with Plutus spending scripts and corrected missing script witnesses and overwritten proposal reference inputs.
- Library migration changes include removal of deprecated `ProtocolParameters` and several era case combinators, extraction of key types and serialisation into `cardano-keys`, and changes to `HasTextEnvelope` instances and `getKesPeriod`.


</details>

<details>
  <summary>cardano-rpc</summary>

- New `ReadMempool` method on the UTxO RPC submit service. It returns the transactions currently in the node's mempool. [PR #1348](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-api/pull/1348)
  - New `WatchMempool` method on the UTxO RPC submit service. It streams transactions as they enter the node's mempool, optionally filtered by a transaction predicate. [PR
  #1350](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-api/pull/1350)
  - `SearchUtxos` now rejects a predicate that names more than 20,000 address terms with `INVALID_ARGUMENT`; repeated addresses count towards the limit. `ReadUtxos` already had the same limit on its
  keys. [PR #1358](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-api/pull/1358)

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Network</summary>

<!-- TODO(network team): review. Summarised from ouroboros-network 1.2.0.0 → 2.0.0.0, network-mux 0.11.0.0 → 1.0.0.0, cardano-diffusion 1.1.1.0 → 1.3.0.1. -->
- Removed `NodeToClientV_16` – `NodeToClientV_22`.
- Fixed an inbound governor stall where a stale `MuxFinished` for a superseded connection could block it indefinitely. It is now ignored and traced as `TrStaleMuxFinished`.
- Fixed a race where a responder could start before its connection was registered.
- Reworked churn and hot-demotion scoring. Decisions carry their scores in traces, and there are new `peerSelection.churn.*` gauges.
- Fairer warm→hot promotion of recently demoted peers.
- Local root changes (addresses, advertise flag) apply immediately instead of waiting for DNS re-resolution.
- `network-mux`: messages are chunk-encoded in the protocol's own thread up to a soft buffer limit, reducing memory retention.
- `network-mux`: the message length moved from `TraceChannelSendStart` to `TraceChannelSendEnd`.
- Tx-submission duration counters no longer truncate sub-millisecond waits.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Consensus</summary>

<!-- TODO(consensus team): review. Summarised from ouroboros-consensus 4.2.1.0 → 5.2.0.0 (root CHANGELOG.md at the CHaP 5.2.0.0 revision). -->
- Node-to-client versions below `NodeToClientV_23` were pruned, along with `GetProposedPParamsUpdates`, `GetStakeDistribution` and `GetPoolDistr` (CBOR tags 4, 5 and 21 are now rejected).
- The default (Mithril) snapshot policy now takes a snapshot every `40 * k` slots with no offset, instead of every 432,000 slots with an offset of 388,800: one snapshot a day on mainnet, one in five landing on an epoch boundary.
- Snapshots are written by a dedicated background thread, decoupled from LedgerDB garbage collection.
- The resolved snapshot policy is traced at startup (`ConfiguredSnapshotPolicy`).
- An `ImplausibleSnapshotPolicy` warning is emitted when the write delay or rate limit is at least as long as the interval, which mainly matters on networks with short slots.
- The hard fork combinator mempool re-encodes a transaction from its origin era into the current era, instead of translating it through every intermediate era.
- Tracing a Dijkstra block that failed validation no longer crashes the tracing thread.
- `db-truncater` gains `--leios` to truncate the LeiosDB along with the ImmutableDB.
- Groundwork for Leios (endorser-block mempool measure, LeiosDB), disabled by default.
- Groundwork for Peras (epoch context, voting committee, vote/cert tracers), disabled by default.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Ledger</summary>

<!-- TODO(ledger team): review. Summarised from cardano-ledger-core 1.21 → 1.22, conway 1.23 → 1.24, dijkstra 0.3 → 0.4, binary 1.9.0.1 → 1.10.1.0. -->
<!-- QUESTION for ledger team: cardano-ledger-core 1.22.0.0 "Change `decodeMetadatum` to require definite-length chunks in indefinite-length bytestrings" — is this gated on protocol version 12? If not, it tightens validation on mainnet and must be called out above. -->
- IPv4 relay addresses are encoded in network byte order (the fix already shipped in 11.1.3).
- New protocol parameter for future eras: CIP-50 maximum pledge leverage (no effect before it is set).
- New protocol parameter for future eras: CIP-23 minimum pool margin (no effect before it is set).
- From protocol version 12 (Dijkstra): `CertifiedVRF`, `Text` and tuple decoders accept indefinite-length encodings.
- From protocol version 12 (Dijkstra): `LeiosCert` rejects an oversized signers bitfield.
- Dijkstra-era progress:
  - CIP-164 Leios committee selection with BLS-keyed stake pool snapshots;
  - new Leios protocol parameters;
  - Peras protocol parameters (certificate validation disabled);
  - sub-transactions with their own execution-unit/fee accounting;
  - a per-transaction `is_valid` flag in the block body.
- `cardano-ledger-api` adds `queryNonMyopicMemberRewards`.
- `cardano-ledger-api` exposes a pool's BLS key.
- API changes across eras:
  - predicate failure constructors renamed (e.g. `StakeKeyAlreadyRegisteredDELEG` → `DelegAccountAlreadyRegistered`);
  - `era` type parameter on `PoolCert`/`StakePoolParams`;
  - transaction-level-aware Plutus `LedgerTxInfo`;
  - more `ToJSON`/`FromJSON` instances.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Plutus</summary>

- Plutus V4 is now ready to use (requires protocol version 12). This release does not include new primitives - V4 currently has the same set of primitives as V1-V3 on mainnet. New primitives will be enabled at a later release.
- The CIP-0168 builtins `keepPolicies`/`dropPolicies` get a cost model (8 parameters).
- `keepPolicies`/`dropPolicies` fail on a `Value` with more than 8191 policies.
- `Value` caches per-currency negative-amount counts, making `keepPolicies`/`dropPolicies` logarithmic in the size of the `Value`; the costing of `insertCoin`, `unionValue`, `scaleValue` and `unValueData` was updated accordingly.
- UPLC now supports using `case` on `Data`. This only supports `Data` objects of the form `Constr i args`. The tag `i` selects the branch. Matching on any other `Datab object fails. Here, `Constr` is a constructor of `Data`, not to be confused with the `constr` AST node. Requires Plutus Core 1.2.0 (if using Plinth, add `{-# OPTIONS_GHC -fplugin-opt Plinth.Plugin:target-version=1.2.0 #-}` ).

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Tracing</summary>

- Config change: `TraceOptionForwarder.connQueueSize` and `TraceOptionForwarder.disconnQueueSize` have been replaced by a single `TraceOptionForwarder.queueSize`. To migrate without behaviour change, pick the higher of both previous values for it.
- Expose Prometheus label sets as `# TYPE ... gauge` for full conformance with text exposition format (fixes https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/issues/6706).
- Safeguard against some Windows systems not properly setting up their terminals for UTF-8 output (fixes https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/issues/6711).
- The `slotsMissed_int` metric no longer counts the slots that elapse while block forging is disabled (fixes https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/issues/6698).
- Addressed stale `BlockFetch.Decision` trace namespaces, so the actually emitted `PeersFetch` and `PeerStarvedUs` messages can now be configured (fixes https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/issues/6667).
- Fixed a small memory leak when using trace forwarding.
- Tracing changes visible to log consumers:
  - Mempool rejections always carry `errdetails`
  - The detailed `"tx"` field of mempool traces is now the CBOR in hex
  - New namespaces `Mempool.CapacityChanged`,
    `Snapshot.ConfiguredSnapshotPolicy`, `Snapshot.ImplausibleSnapshotPolicy`,
    `RPC.SubmitService.ReadMempool.Span` and
    `RPC.SubmitService.WatchMempool.Span`
  - Peras certificate inclusion and vote forging traces under `Peras.Cert.Inclusion` and `Peras.Vote.Forging`
  - The ledger predicate failure kind for an already-registered delegation account is now `DelegAccountAlreadyRegistered`

</details>
